pages.article_html:
Kojuko Gluttons

Level 4 · Adventuring · Tanvu · Kojan

Go to the northeast and slay one Kojuko Glutton. Bring it's hand back to Oki.

Objectives

Obtain a Bloody Glutton Hand

Description

1) Speak to Oki in Tanvu. 2) Kill Kojuko Gluttons to the northeast until you have a Bloody Glutton Hand. 3) Return to Oki.

Notes

Per the Forgotten Horde wiki's Tanvu page (Dallerjuba Village), 2007-2008 (http://web.archive.org/web/20080723045202/http://targonor.net/vg/pmwiki.php?n=Main.Tanvu).

1 recorded disagreement about this quest — ends npc (wiki.silkyvenom.com:80).

Another account

A second source described this quest differently. Both are kept here; neither is a correction of the other.

Objectives as recorded by fandom

Bloody Glutton Hand (1) Go to the northeast and slay one Kojuko Glutton. Bring it's hand back to Oki. ...The kojuko Gluttons to the northeast have a strange attaction to our magic. They have been destroying Tanvu's magical barriers for reasons that we are unaware of...

pages.article_html:
Kojuko Manhunters

Level 4 · Adventuring · Tanvu · Kojan

Engage in combat with Kojuko Manhunters until you understand their fighting style, then report back to Juu.

Objectives

Slay Kojuko Manhunters

Description

1) Speak to Juu in Tanvu. 2) Slay Kojuko Manhunters until you have an underestanding of their fighting style. 3) Return to Juu.

Notes

Kojuko Manhunter Level 5 (Demonic, Imp, 2 dot, aggro) I had to kill 5 to learn the information.

3 recorded disagreements about this quest — level (wiki.silkyvenom.com:80), level (the Forgotten Horde wiki), prev quest (silkyvenom).

Another account

A second source described this quest differently. Both are kept here; neither is a correction of the other.

Objectives as recorded by fandom

Understanding of the Kojuko Fighting Style Engage in combat with Kojuko Manhunters until you understandtheir fighting style, and then report back to Juu. ...The Kojuko Manhunter that assualted us employs a very primitive form of fighting. We would like to learn about this in a hope to adapt our own style to it....

findings.observation: Gluttons displays level 4, Adventuring, Tanvu, Kojan, Oki as starter and hand-in, and Dallerjuba Village as series. Manhunters displays level 4 and Juu as starter and hand-in in Shang Village. Canonical client identities and historical patch remain unverified.

Gluttons Objectives says Obtain a Bloody Glutton Hand. Description says kill Gluttons to the northeast until you have a hand; summary says slay one. The fandom-attributed objective explicitly prints Bloody Glutton Hand (1). These are separate quantity observations, not proof of a guaranteed drop or operative kill requirement.

Manhunters Objectives says Slay Kojuko Manhunters, and its description says until you understand their fighting style. Notes prints Kojuko Manhunter Level 5 (Demonic, Imp, 2 dot, aggro) and I had to kill 5 to learn the information. The first-person count is an attributed report, not a verified fixed requirement. The fandom objective names Understanding of the Kojuko Fighting Style.

Gluttons lists Previous Avenging Oki and Next Training With Juu; Juu (Quest) instead lists Previous Kojuko Gluttons. Manhunters lists Previous Training With Juu and Next The Unforgotten, whereas Juu lists Next Kojuko Manhunters, The Unforgotten. Labels alone do not establish identity equivalence between Training With Juu and Juu (Quest), or an enforced prerequisite chain.

Gluttons preserves one ends npc disagreement attributed to wiki.silkyvenom.com:80. Manhunters preserves three disagreements: level attributed to wiki.silkyvenom.com:80 and the Forgotten Horde wiki, and prev quest attributed to silkyvenom. Alternate values are not supplied in the visible disagreement text. No query URLs were requested; unresolved values remain withheld.

Gluttons Location prints -16408, -49970, 187. Manhunters Location prints -21770, -62875, 3344, while its map says Starts spot 8, Juu, Tanvu (-21711, -67633). Coordinate contexts remain separate; units, conversions and verified spawns remain unknown.

Both Details explicitly print Repeatable No. Coin reward is 50 for Gluttons and 60 for Manhunters, without denomination. Reward labels and embedded tooltips remain in full article HTML and source records; no choice rules, canonical item IDs or denomination are inferred.

Both Source links point to MMODB quest pages on vgoemulator.net archive. Gluttons Notes also cites a 2007-2008 Forgotten Horde Tanvu page through a Wayback URL. This review uses cached archive transcriptions only; linked originals were not fetched or independently corroborated.
